query: select json_build_object('stores_without_merchant_profile', (select count(*) from public.stores s left join public.merchant_profiles mp on mp.user_id = s.merchant_id where mp.user_id is null), 'products_without_store', (select count(*) from public.products p left join public.stores s on s.id = p.store_id where s.id is null), 'reviews_without_product', (select count(*) from public.reviews r left join public.products p on p.id = r.product_id where r.product_id is not null and p.id is null), 'comments_with_broken_target', (select count(*) from public.comments c left join public.products p on p.id = c.product_id left join public.reviews r on r.id = c.review_id where (c.product_id is null and c.review_id is null) or (c.product_id is not null and p.id is null) or (c.review_id is not null and r.id is null)), 'product_likes_without_product', (select count(*) from public.product_likes l left join public.products p on p.id = l.product_id where p.id is null), 'store_followers_without_store', (select count(*) from public.store_followers f left join public.stores s on s.id = f.store_id where s.id is null), 'messages_without_conversation', (select count(*) from public.messages m left join public.conversations c on c.id = m.conversation_id where c.id is null), 'notifications_without_user', (select count(*) from public.notifications n left join public.users u on u.id = n.user_id where u.id is null)) as referential_integrity from (select 1) as probe limit 1;
